verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented way to choose a storage region or data-residency location for Steel's managed cloud. Residential proxies, BYOP and dedicated IPs control the network egress location, not where data is stored. The pre-built Docker image implies self-hosting is possible, but it is never presented as a residency or region-selection feature, so it does not count as the product delivering this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
